_comment: Quake (360, quake.360.net v3) endpoint path templates + per-run budget for wp_quake.py. The token travels in the X-QuakeToken header on a POST whose JSON body carries the query (favicon.hash:"<mmh3>"). Quake bills in points; the caller gates it `and not free_only`. Overrides the inline _QUAKE_FALLBACK; a missing/bad file degrades to that fallback with a warning.

endpoints._comment: v3 REST paths (joined to https://quake.360.net). search POSTs the favicon.hash query and returns quake_service rows.

budget._comment: per-run guard rails; page_size caps how many service rows one favicon reverse returns.
